claims.object_text: neural gene-regulating homeostasis of the central nervous system
claims.quote: WW domain-containing oxidoreductase (WWOX) is an emerging neural gene-regulating homeostasis of the central nervous system.

claims.object_text: WOREE syndrome and spinocerebellar ataxia and autosomal recessive 12 (SCAR12)
claims.quote: Germline biallelic mutations in WWOX cause WWOX-related epileptic encephalopathy (WOREE) syndrome and spinocerebellar ataxia and autosomal recessive 12 (SCAR12)
neuronal ablation of murine Wwox recapitulates phenotypes of Wwox-null mice leading to intractable epilepsy, hypomyelination, and postnatal lethality.

claims.object_text: intractable epilepsy, hypomyelination, and postnatal lethality
claims.quote: intractable epilepsy, hypomyelination, and postnatal lethality

claims.object_text: AAV-SynI-WWOX (AAV9 harboring WWOX cDNA driven by Synapsin I promoter)
claims.quote: an adeno-associated viral vector (AAV9) harboring murine Wwox or human WWOX cDNA and driven by the human neuronal Synapsin I promoter (AAV-SynI-WWOX).

claims.object_text: rescued brain hyperexcitability and seizures, hypoglycemia, myelination deficits, and premature lethality and behavioral deficits in Wwox-null mice
claims.quote: specific neuronal restoration of WWOX expression rescued brain hyperexcitability and seizures, hypoglycemia, myelination deficits, and the premature lethality and behavioral deficits of Wwox-null mice.

claims.object_text: WWOX gene therapy for WOREE and SCAR12
claims.quote: These findings provide a proof-of-concept for WWOX gene therapy as a promising approach to curing children with WOREE and SCAR12.
